idea-plugin.name: Codex Session Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Keep Codex terminal sessions easy to identify and ready to resume inside JetBrains IDEs.

  • Session-aware tab names: Keep each terminal tab synchronized with its Codex session name.
  • Native activity indicator: Preserve JetBrains' Codex icon and show its animated progress state while Codex is working.
  • Session restoration: Restore the Codex sessions that were open when the IDE closed, including reusable CLI flags such as --yolo.

Codex Session Tabs works automatically with the Reworked Terminal. It uses local process and Codex state information, has no external service, and does not copy transcript contents.
